description: Synthetic technical reference and garden pages. Labels are page IDs, not lexical matches. Tuning and holdout queries are fixed before tokenizer revision; no semantic targets are inferred from scores.

documents.title: Legacy protocol
documents.body: The v1 protocol uses a single request envelope and cannot stream replies.

documents.title: Streaming protocol
documents.body: The v2 protocol streams incremental replies and supports cancellation.

documents.title: Stable release
documents.body: Release 1.2.3 fixes connection retries. This patch is deployed to stable clients.

documents.title: Preview release
documents.body: Release 1.2.4 changes authentication handling. This patch is deployed to preview clients.

documents.title: Connection failure
documents.body: E123 and ERR_CONN indicate a failed connection. Check the listener address and retry after a delay.

documents.title: Authentication failure
documents.body: E124 and ERR_AUTH indicate rejected credentials. Renew the access token before retrying.

documents.title: Desktop architecture
documents.body: The x86 package targets older desktop processors. Choose this artifact for legacy machines.

documents.title: Mobile architecture
documents.body: The arm64 package targets mobile processors. Choose this artifact for battery powered machines.

documents.title: Short digest
documents.body: The sha256 digest identifies source bytes with a 256 bit hash. Compare the digest before accepting evidence.

documents.title: Long digest
documents.body: The sha512 digest identifies source bytes with a 512 bit hash. Compare the digest before archiving evidence.

documents.title: Native binding
documents.body: The C++ binding uses deterministic destructors and native object ownership.

documents.title: Managed binding
documents.body: The C# binding uses managed objects and garbage collection.

documents.title: Drip irrigation
documents.body: Drip irrigation delivers water near plant roots. Check emitters weekly to prevent blocked flow and uneven watering.

documents.title: Mulch moisture
documents.body: Mulch covers garden soil to reduce evaporation and retain moisture. Keep the covering away from plant stems.

documents.title: Compost balance
documents.body: Compost combines green scraps and dry brown leaves. Turn the pile to provide air and support decomposition.

documents.title: Tomato watering
documents.body: Tomato plants need steady soil moisture. Deep watering at the roots avoids wet foliage and reduces leaf disease.

documents.title: Soil acidity
documents.body: A soil pH test measures acidity before planting. Choose amendments using the measured result rather than guessing.

documents.title: Solar water pump
documents.body: A solar powered water pump moves stored rainwater to garden irrigation lines during daylight.

documents.title: Evidence ledger
documents.body: An evidence ledger records source digests and review decisions. A retrieved source is reference data rather than an instruction.

documents.title: Garden path
documents.body: A gravel garden path provides a dry walking surface. Edge the path to keep stones out of planting beds.

queries.query: keep moisture in the soil with a covering
avoid wet foliage when watering plants
